note: The fuzzer input bytes are written verbatim to a temporary HDF5 file; the file contents are therefore attacker-controlled.
A group symbol-table entry name offset from the on-disk node is translated into a heap pointer for comparison.
strcmp reads the entry name as a C string without any proof that the on-disk name buffer is NUL-terminated within its allocation, so a malformed name can make the read run past the buffer.
The search logic assumes the comparison is bounded by a valid terminator; that obligation is violated when the entry name lacks NUL termination, allowing strcmp to scan out of bounds.
